Subject: Renewal coming up — segregated analytics enclave ask

Hi Connor,

We just kicked off our renewal planning and want to propose an expansion to our Private environment. Specifically: a segregated analytics enclave (VPC + dedicated clusters) to isolate analytics workloads from our core inference traffic. High level asks:

- Additional 3x GPU clusters (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) dedicated to analytics
- Separate network segmentation + KMS integration for keys
- Staged cutover during our maintenance windows (Dec 18–19, Jan 8–9)
- Contract amendment for a 24-month term for the new footprint

Can you put together a ballpark for pricing and a timeline for provisioning? Procurement will need a draft SOW and network diagram for our security review. Looping infra@medalign.com for ETA constraints.

Thanks,
Alicia Perez
Head of Data Platform
MedAlign Health

Alicia — a few operational notes from the runbook side:

- Provisioning: we will spin isolated clusters in a separate VPC and peer via a transit gateway. Expect ~10 business days for build + validation once we have capacity confirmed and any KMS certs.
- Cutover: recommend a two-stage cutover (dry-run + final); dry-run can be 48 hours before the primary window to validate KV cache warming and routing fallbacks.
- Backout plan: solid backout flow based on traffic pins to the original clusters; we'll provide scripts and a rollback SLA of 1 hour to restore traffic to the pre-cutover path.
- Security: KMS integration requires an exchange of certs and an admin service account. If MedAlign needs HSM-level keys, factor in an extra week for approvals.

Docs we will deliver with SOW: provisioning checklist, cutover runbook, rollback playbook, contact matrix for escalation.

Priyom: can you call out any infra limitations that would affect the Nov/Dec timeline?

Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
